bio:
This LinkedIn page for Bosch Security and Safety Systems is no longer active.
The business has been acquired by Triton and is now part of the Keenfinity Group, an independent company delivering professional communication and security solutions that connect and protect people and assets. Keenfinity Group combines leading brands and expertise across Audio, Video Systems, Intrusion & Access, and Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS), serving customers worldwide.

To continue receiving product updates, insights, and news, please follow our dedicated LinkedIn pages: 
• Video Systems: IQSIGHT https://www.linkedin.com/company/iqsight
• Intrusion & Access: Radionix https://www.linkedin.com/company/radionix
• Conference Solutions | Keenfinity Group https://www.linkedin.com/company/bosch-conference-solutions
• Public Address & Voice Alarm | Keenfinity Group https://www.linkedin.com/company/public-address-solutions

More information: www.keenfinity-group.com
